# Agentic First

> Top-level map for company-first agentic creation:
> Open Company Information plus an Open Tool Directory for agents,
> companies, and builders.

Canonical site:

- https://agentic-first.co/

Alternate domain:

- https://agent-first.co/ redirects to https://agentic-first.co/

## Main Routes

- `/` - Agentic First route map for Open Company Information and the Open Tool Directory
- `/companies/` - Open Company Information publishing overview
- `/companies/mcp` - company/profile MCP endpoint
- `/companies/healthz` - company/profile health endpoint
- `/companies/schemas/` - canonical company/profile schemas
- `/companies/feedback` - company/profile feedback endpoint
- `/companies/llms.txt` - machine index for the company/profile directory
- `/directory/` - Open Tool Directory seed catalog
- `/directory/llms.txt` - machine index for the Open Tool Directory

## Source Repositories

- Top-level site: https://github.com/yqup/agentic-first
- Open Company Information and Open Tool Directory product code: https://github.com/yqup/pitch-mcp
- Brand guidelines: https://github.com/yqup/agentic-first/blob/main/BRAND-GUIDELINES.md

## Concept

Agentic First means company-first agentic creation: designing public
information and private access paths so agents can read, verify, and act
safely. The top-level site maps the two separate product surfaces.

Use this distinction:

- Humans set goals, values, approvals, risk appetite, and judgement calls.
- Agents read structured information, perform bounded work, and escalate where approval is required.
- Organisations publish source-owned facts instead of relying only on third-party profiles or scraped pages.

## Product Surfaces

Use `/companies/` when the task concerns Open Company Information:
publishing/storing company information online, schema validation,
submissions, scans, feedback, or the public MCP tools.

Use `/directory/` when the task concerns the Open Tool Directory:
tools, standards, models, runtimes, protocols, and operations surfaces for
agent-native work.

The top-level homepage includes two Directory-derived sections:
UK / European-company check and sovereign AI shortlist. Treat residency,
company jurisdiction, and sovereign AI labels as field notes that require
vendor and contract verification before sensitive use.

## Legacy Company/Profile Compatibility

The legacy public MCP endpoint is:

- https://directory.agentic-first.co/mcp

The target endpoint is:

- https://agentic-first.co/companies/mcp

Keep the legacy endpoint available during migration. Proxying is safer
than redirecting for MCP clients until client compatibility is confirmed.
